WITH per_race AS (
  SELECT raceId,
         AVG(points) AS avg_points,
         AVG(wins) AS avg_wins
  FROM constructorStandings
  WHERE points > 6.0
  GROUP BY raceId
),
with_overall AS (
  SELECT raceId,
         avg_points,
         avg_wins,
         AVG(avg_wins) OVER () AS overall_avg_wins
  FROM per_race
)
SELECT raceId,
       avg_points,
       avg_wins,
       avg_wins - overall_avg_wins AS difference
FROM with_overall
WHERE overall_avg_wins IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY difference DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10
